answer_1.quote: Our task is knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) based on a natural language question q and knowledge graph G.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are answers to natural language questions generated by the LMP framework using knowledge from a knowledge graph and LLMs.

answer_2.quote: For all datasets, exact match accuracy (Hits@1) is used as the evaluation metric following previous works with F1 score in Appendix E.1.
